title: Greater Boston Mathematics League
text:
The GBML is the Greater Boston Mathematics League. It is a good competition in the New England area and there are five meets for all schools participating. The top 6 schools move onto the semi-finals. The rounds are different for every meet and include everything up to precalculus.


Scoring

1. The first question receives one point, the second question two points, and the third question three points, unless otherwise specified.

2. The individual’s yearly score is the sum of his best four out of five meet scores.

3. The team scores consist of the sum of the scores of the five meets.


You can find out more by going to http://www.gbml.net/.
